name: Maaya Uchida
bio:
Maaya Uchida is a Japanese actress, singer and voice actress affiliated with the agency I'm Enterprise. She's the older sister of voice actor Yuuma Uchida and wife of voice actor Ishikawa Kaito.

In February 2014, she won the Best New Actress Award in the 8th Seiyu Awards.
